sol (PM): Heads-up — customer X asked for a private pilot that needs tenant-level SLAs + HSM-backed keys. We have a launch window target of 3 weeks. Can we map the hard dependencies and figure scope cuts?

ajay (runtime): Thanks. Main runtime items: per-tenant model pinning, cold-start prewarm, and KV-cache isolation. Prewarm is the biggest infra lift if we want <200ms p95 on first token.

leah (infra): Prewarm requires reserved GPU slots or a fast prewarm pool. We can carve burst capacity but that affects other pilots. Need to know expected QPS and tail percentiles.

priya (security): HSM/KMS integration is non-trivial: we need KMS approval, HSM provisioning (or cloud KMS config), and key rotation docs. Also SCIM for tenant access. Timeline depends on compliance review (2w).

samir (platform): If we de-scope HSM for MVP and use envelope encryption with our managed KMS, we can buy ~1 week. But customer X said HSM is mandatory for data residency audit.

sol (PM): Understood. Proposal: split pilot into Phase A (customer-facing pilot without HSM but with strict logs + isolation) and Phase B (full HSM + rotation + audit). Does that work from runtime/infra POV?

ajay (runtime): Phase A ok if we accept slightly higher cold-starts and limit concurrency. We can ship model pinning + KV isolation in 1 week if infra provides prewarm pool. Phase B needs runtime changes for HSM key retrieval latency handling and async key caching. Estimate +2 weeks.

leah (infra): We can try a small prewarm pool scoped to the customer (2 GPUs) for Phase A. Need a signed commitment on expected qps window and burst pattern. Also need to schedule deploy slot — ops calendar is tight next week.

priya (security): For Phase A we can do managed KMS with an elevated audit trail, plus a stubbed HSM plan. But legal will flag it if customer insisted on HSM in writing. We need their written consent to proceed with phased approach.

samir (platform): Ok so risks: 1) customer rejects phased approach 2) prewarm capacity impacts other pilots 3) missing KMS evidence for compliance.

sol (PM): Action proposal: 1) I’ll ask customer for written approval for phased pilot by EOD today. 2) @leah please tentatively reserve a 2-GPU prewarm pool for next sprint and confirm by EOD. 3) @ajay can you drop a minimal runtime config (PR stub) that enables per-tenant pinning and a toggle for cold-start fallback? 4) @priya start the KMS/HSM intake and list exact artifacts legal needs.

ajay (runtime): Will open WIP PR now — includes a feature-flagged prewarm hook and KV namespace isolation. Code snippet in PR description:```yaml
feature_flags:
  tenant_pin: true
  prewarm_hook: "enabled"
prewarm:
  pool_size: 2
  warm_policy: "on_demand"
```

leah (infra): Reserved tentative pool and added a blocker note on ops calendar. If customer QPS > 1000 we need to revisit.

priya (security): Intake started. Requested: SOC attestation, key rotation policy, threat model for HSM integration, and scoping doc. ETA: initial checklist 48h.

samir (platform): I’ll add a routing fallback to lower-tier model (faster quant) in case prewarm pool saturates. That keeps user-facing latency bounded but reduces cost predictability.

sol (PM): Cool. Finalize acceptance criteria below so we agree on launch gates. If we miss any, we roll to Phase B or postpone.

sol (PM): Acceptance criteria (short):```- Prewarm pool provisioned and validated (2-GPU, smoke tests pass)
- Runtime per-tenant pinning + KV isolation feature flagged and smoke-tested
- SLA target: first-token p95 < 500ms for pilot baseline traffic (<=200 RPS sustained)
- Security checklist items 1-4 acknowledged by legal and security
- Customer signed phased-approach consent
```

ajay (runtime): I added an automated smoke test for warm/cold flows and a perf-collector dashboard. Will link PR -> smoke job.

leah (infra): Smoke tests scheduled in staging tonight. Will post results in this thread.

priya (security): Noted. I’ll ping legal and loop them into the thread; will post checklist link.

sol (PM): Thanks everyone. If staging smoke passes, we aim for a soft pilot on Mon (3 days after approvals). If any gate fails, we escalate to emergency triage and decide between cut scope or delay. :+1:

deploy-bot: deploy request created by ajay (runtime) — id: deploy-4312 — status: pending

leah (infra): Staging smoke: warm flows OK, cold-start p95 ~680ms (above gate). Need runtime tweak or larger prewarm pool.

ajay (runtime): Saw the 680ms. I'll push a micro-tweak to the prewarm hook to keep 1 worker per GPU warm which should shave ~160ms. Pushing in 10m.

leah (infra): Noted. If that doesn't get us <500ms we'll need to expand pool to 3 GPUs (ops approval required).

sol (PM): Keep updates here. If we end up needing 3 GPUs, I'll scope cost + customer signoff. Thanks.
